name: Vedang - Green Burger | Alexa Berlin
description: Welcome to Vedang - green burger, where every bite supports sustainability. At Vedang, we are all about redefining taste. That's why we're thrilled to introduce our smash burgers: locally sourced, sustainable beef that's a treat for your taste buds.

name: Restaurant Bieberbau
description: Bieberbau at Durlacher Str. 15 in Berlin-Wilmersdorf is part of a former studio and dwelling house. Built 1893/94 by Wilhelm Walther for the sculptuor Richard Bieber, it was nearly completely destroyed by a firebomb during World War II. Only the rooms and decoration of what is now the restaurant survived. The stucco ornamentation you can admire here have been created by the most advanced students and trainedcraftsmen of the principal and owner. He maintained a plasterer's and sculptuor's studio. The decorations depict different motives from mythology and rural life. They show advanced technical skills. The premises in their organic design provide an insight into the stuccateurs' craftmenship unique for Berlin around the turn of the twentieth century. They offer a unique spatial experience the qualitiy and complexitiy of which were out of the ordinary. In the backyard of the house there were several studios, amongst others those of the expressionist work group ,,Die Brücke" (,,The Bridge"). Between 1910 and 1913 Max Pechstein and Ernst Ludwig Kirchner worked here.

name: Hasty Pastry
description: PIDAZA & PIADINA "Is the new kind of healthy flatbread" Pidaza is a flatbread baked in northern Italy according to a family recipe that works completely without animal fats, eggs, milk and is very thin. There are two varieties to choose from - one with wheat flour and cold-pressed grape seed oil and one with spelled flour. It is covered with various fresh, high-quality and natural ingredients, such as with mozzarella, avocado, tofu, fresh vine tomatoes or cooked ham, salami, tuna and much more. Our Pidaza is prepared on a special plate without fat, fresh and live for you. How it's goes! First you choose a Pidaza, then the size and finally the covering you want.

name: Vedis
description: We offer you the entire culinary diversity of the Indian subcontinent. Our cooking style involves both elements from the north of the country and hence the Himalayan region and the southern tip of India. Besides a number of specialties from chicken, lamb and duck, you may also look forward to delicious fresh fish dishes. Especially popular are the speacialties from the Tandoori grill. Our comfortable and cozy Restaurant can be found in Prenzlauer Berg, or more precisely in the Schönhauser Allee 142 in Berlin. Only a few meters from the Eberswalder Straße, you can dine at the epicenter of Berlin's nightlife and can stop directly in one of the many bars after dessert. Many of our guests, however, chose it in Vedi's so good that they even order the same one or another cocktail. Enjoy our round the clock Happy Hour cocktails from € 4.90 In the event that "your drink is not on the card, we are happy to provide any drink individually prepared''.
